purpose: One place that knows whose session a tab is in, and clears every registered in-memory cache of a person's content when the person changes.
namedChanges: the first comment line loses its cycle tag, and the fourth no longer names the source app's test file; no code changed.

library.title: Whose session this tab is (clears caches on change)
library.note: Only the one place that knows whose tab it is and clears every registered cache when the person changes; it holds no credential. For signing in take signin; for the copy itself take session-cache.
